facts.text: For a four-month validation of a heavy off-road collision mitigation system, the defensible route is an analytical safety case plus targeted physical tests, with simulation presented under a credibility framework.
facts.quote: For a four-month validation the defensible route is an analytical safety case plus targeted physical tests, with simulation presented under a credibility framework.

facts.text: The sourced basis for a four-month off-road collision mitigation validation includes ISO 21815-3's calculated CxS distance for each machine model, using ISO 3450 brake data.
facts.quote: ISO 21815-3's calculated CxS distance per model (using ISO 3450 brake data)

facts.text: The sourced basis for a four-month off-road collision mitigation validation includes ISO 16001 annex tests for each sensor technology.
facts.quote: ISO 16001 annex tests per sensor technology

facts.text: The sourced basis for a four-month off-road collision mitigation validation includes ISO 19014 MPLr with Part 5 tables.
An off-road collision mitigation safety case should separately analyze two safety functions: failure to intervene when needed, and intervention when unsafe or unnecessary.
facts.quote: two separately analyzed safety functions: failure to intervene when needed, and intervention when it is unsafe or unnecessary

facts.text: No off-road regulator has committed to accept virtual evidence for collision mitigation validation.
facts.quote: No off-road regulator has committed to accept virtual evidence

facts.text: For off-road collision mitigation validation, simulation should be framed as coverage and design evidence and qualified against physical tests in the manner of Euro NCAP or R171 Annex 5.
facts.quote: simulation should be framed as coverage and design evidence, qualified against physical tests in the Euro NCAP or R171 Annex 5 manner
